iterations.finding: A broad routing rewrite would risk regressing accepted long and risk branch geometry.
iterations.resolution: The implementation confines local group channels to adjacent ordinary process branches, explicitly excludes feedback and risk from that helper, and leaves the existing global long-branch fallback in place.

iterations.finding: Moving the feedback label locally merely because the path is local could introduce label-to-node or label-to-label collisions.
iterations.resolution: The renderer computes the natural feedback label box and removes footer forcing only when that box clears both all node rectangles and packed process-label bounds; otherwise the footer fallback remains.

iterations.finding: The compact result could be a special-case success while same-row, bottom-footer, multi-feedback, long-branch, or risk geometry regressed.
iterations.resolution: The exact 18-node regression and the complete native-diagram module pass on the functional head, including the existing footer, long-branch, risk, and feedback regression coverage.

iterations.finding: Changing accepted renderer/test bytes invalidates historical digest bindings and must not be hidden by rewriting old receipts.
iterations.resolution: A new process-feedback-routing acceptance receipt parents the latest Schaubild acceptance, binds exactly native_diagram.py and test_native_diagram.py, and publication precedence supersedes only those current bytes while historical receipts remain immutable.

iterations.finding: Focused tests and geometry assertions alone would not establish that the final diagram is visually usable or that the repository still validates as a whole.
iterations.resolution: The exact Chrome screenshot shows the local readable 'neue Planung' label without node or edge-label overlap, canvas remains 2588x1118 with 152px right reserve, and post-successor make validate passes Ruff, compile, registry validation, and 1657/1657 tests.
